findings.title: Special cylindrical/tapered shapes use rectangular volume for blast distance
findings.evidence: tower_floor55 has radius5.25 but point local(5,0,5) is distance0 by OBB clamp and distance1.8210678 from cylinder surface. Radius1 blast falsely destroys it. tower_roof55 upper corners similarly contain no visible or physical roof.
findings.minimal_solution: Special narrowphase distance for cylinder and frustum: cylinder radial/y excess; roof distance from(r,y) to finite trapezoid profile. Retain AABB for broadphase.

findings.title: Destructible tower disks/roofs turn into giant box debris
findings.evidence: New cells with tower_floor55/tower_roof55 shapes enter existing generic pool path that always assigns BoxShape and leaves unit BoxMesh. Thus10.5m disk and12m tapered roof become square/cuboid debris with mismatching collision.
findings.minimal_solution: Assign shape-specific mesh and collider for these two new shapes and reset pooled mesh/shape/scale on every reuse, or split these large elements into bounded stone debris.

review_passes: All-cells AABB extent spatial insertion visits each overlapping8m bucket; _indices_box seen dictionary deduplicates indices.
Coarse sections refine to exact shapes of all intersecting alive masonry, retaining second skin and repeat hits.
Immediate explosion and delayed support both call sync; killed mapped masonry colliders are disabled deferred.
Existing merlon, courtyard and stairs maps are exempt from duplicate shape creation.

Furniture and keep-floor coarse bodies retain original _break_collision_near path, while sync skips them. Their blast filtering remains center-based to avoid silently broadening old furnishing damage.
Tilted arcade/arch cells use full Euler basis for bounds/distance/shape, not just Y rotation.
notes: New tower floor/roof pass through generic _brick_transform jitter rather than their prior flat Mesh transform; consider excluding these structural surfaces from jitter to preserve exact visual/physical alignment.
Direct hit/physics acceptance remains with root native harness; no Godot or tests launched by reviewer.
